name: RfcArchiveOperation
preview: resolve the exact requested RFC and requested scope_kind exact_rfc or reviewed_branch

exact_rfc contains exactly the requested RFC; reviewed_branch requires the requested RFC to be parentless at evaluation time and contains it plus every current direct subordinate, with no child-count business cap
capture every member rfc_id, current RFC revision and local archive_state; show active members as would_change and archived members as excluded_prearchived
order exact_rfc as the sole requested member; order reviewed_branch with requested root first then direct children by rfc_id UTF-8 bytes ascending
compute SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1 over the complete ordered current scope; transport paging is presentation only and never supplies authoritative member revisions
archive: resolve exact command replay before owner preparation/current-state reads; replay returns the original immutable ArchiveRfcResultV1
inside one UnitOfWork re-resolve the complete current scope and recompute SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1; require exact equality with reviewed_scope_fingerprint
identify active members that will change and already-archived members that remain untouched
if no member changes return semantic NO_CHANGE ArchiveRfcResultV1 with null rfc_archive_operation_id and create no operation/event/audit
allocate rfc_archive_operation_id; after Foundation inserts the command receipt, insert the operation row

for each active reviewed member set only local_archive_state=archived, increment RFC revision once, insert immutable operation membership and one archived event using resulting RFC revision as event order
already archived members receive no membership/event and are not claimed by this operation

audit scalar changed_rfc_count/excluded_prearchived_count plus scope fingerprint with exactly one audit result ref to the rfc_archive_operation; exact member identities remain in operation membership/archive-event rows
persist exact fixed-size ArchiveRfcResultV1 and commit
restore_operation: resolve exact replay before owner preparation/current-state reads
inside one UnitOfWork load the exact immutable origin operation and its complete membership
for each member read current archive state and latest archive event ordered by resulting_rfc_revision
eligible member must still be archived and latest event must be archived from this exact origin operation; independently restored or later rearchived members are skipped and never overwritten
if no member remains eligible return semantic NO_CHANGE with RfcArchiveOperationV1 whose first page contains at most 32 exact RfcArchiveOperationMemberV1 items

after Foundation inserts the command receipt transition every eligible member to active, increment revision once and append restored events referencing the origin operation; do not cap mutation cardinality to the response page
audit scalar changed_rfc_count with exactly one audit result ref to the origin rfc_archive_operation; exact restored identities remain the restored event rows

after all eligible mutations, derive each RfcArchiveOperationMemberV1 from immutable operation membership plus current RFC state and latest event by greatest resulting_rfc_revision; order ordinal then rfc_id
persist exact RfcArchiveOperationV1 with at most 32 first-page members and GetRfcArchiveOperation-compatible continuation, then commit

operation_member_projection.latest_event_rule: greatest resulting_rfc_revision for the RFC; timestamps never decide latest event
operation_member_projection.restore_eligible_rule: true exactly when current_archive_state=archived, latest_event_type=archived and latest_event_origin_archive_operation_id equals the queried origin operation
operation_member_projection.rule: The 32-member command-response page is solely an exact replay/transport representation bound; complete operation membership remains mutation authority and GetRfcArchiveOperation supports ordinary requested limits 1..500 default 100.

scope_fingerprint.purpose: Exact deterministic freshness token for archive preview and writer-time revalidation. It binds complete current RFC membership, each member revision and local archive state without requiring an unbounded client member list.
scope_fingerprint.canonical_object: Build the exact closed object {schema:'SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1',requested_rfc_id,scope_kind,members:[{rfc_id,rfc_revision,archive_state},...]}; no extra keys are permitted.
field_validation: requested_rfc_id and every member rfc_id are exact validated immutable RFC identities
rfc_revision is a positive integer and boolean is not an integer
member rfc_id values are unique and the requested RFC is the first member
scope_derivation: exact_rfc contains exactly the requested RFC regardless of hierarchy role

reviewed_branch requires the requested RFC to have no active parent; it contains the requested RFC followed by every active direct child and never recursively expands beyond the accepted two RFC levels
if reviewed_branch requested RFC becomes subordinate before writer revalidation, the request is stale
scope_fingerprint.ordering: requested RFC first; reviewed_branch direct children sort by rfc_id UTF-8 bytes ascending. Array position is authoritative ordering and ordinal is excluded from member objects.
scope_fingerprint.canonicalization: Serialize the exact closed object with LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exactly: ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), then UTF-8 encode. Hash lowercase SHA-256 over those exact bytes.
scope_fingerprint.versioning_rule: Any change to keys, scope semantics, ordering or canonicalization requires a new profile name; existing operation/preview fingerprints are never reinterpreted.

rules: archive/restore changes only SOMA-local RFC presentation state
archive never changes source lifecycle/status, hierarchy, SR links, WFM/Task/Objective state or Communications
branch membership is explicit preview/revalidation authority rather than an implicit recursive side effect
operation-scoped restore prevents an older operation from activating a member whose archive provenance changed later
valid branch/operation size is not limited by request, audit-payload, audit-result-ref or replay-response collection bounds; exact member history is row-wise persistence authority
performance: Complete archive scope/member scans use indexed two-level RFC/history reads. Hash input and row-wise mutation may scale with actual branch membership, but no duplicate unbounded member collection is copied into request, audit JSON, audit result refs or command response. Restore command response materializes at most 32 member projections after all eligible row-wise mutations; larger operation history remains available by paged query.
